tips.title: Assembling Multi-Part Gun Barrels (Trumpeter, AFV Club)
tips.text: For multi-part gun barrels like those found in Trumpeter and AFV Club kits, start by painting all parts separately for easier handling. Use tweezers and a fine brush for accuracy. Once dry, assemble using superglue like Loctite Liquid Professional. Hold parts together for 30 seconds to ensure a strong bond. For alignment, use a drill bit matching the barrel's diameter to maintain consistency.

tips.title: Using Jigs for Wing Alignment (Eduard, ICM)
tips.text: For perfectly aligned wings, create a jig using foam board or cardstock. Draw the wing shape, then cut out the inner section to create a recess for the wing root. Once both wings are placed in the jig, apply Tamiya Extra Thin Cement along the root, allowing the glue to wick in. After curing, remove wings from the jig and apply weight to ensure proper alignment while drying.

tips.title: Installing Photo-Etch Parts (Eduard, Arma Hobby)
tips.text: Before installing photo-etch parts, paint the attachment points on the main kit with a contrasting color. This aids in alignment and allows any overspray to be easily cleaned. Use tweezers and a fine brush with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner to apply Micro Set liquid adhesive to the back of the photo-etch parts, ensuring even coverage. Allow drying before installing.

tips.title: Working with Resin Conversion Kits (Clear Prop Models)
tips.text: Resin kits require more patience due to their delicate nature. Before assembly, soak parts in warm water with a drop of dish soap to remove any mold release agent. After drying, use CA glue like Testors Instant Krazy Glue to assemble, applying sparingly to avoid excess. For filling gaps, use Vallejo Plastic Putty, applying thin layers and sanding between applications.

tips.title: Assembling Tracks: Individual Links vs. Vinyl vs. Workable (Meng)
tips.text: For individual link tracks like Meng's, paint and assemble links separately. Use superglue for joining, applying sparingly to avoid excess. For vinyl tracks, paint before assembly, using Loctite Super Glue Gel to attach links, allowing excess to be easily wiped off. For workable tracks, paint after assembly, using Vallejo Acrylic Thinner for easier manipulation.
